checks.name: exported names
checks.expected: every name py4gw exports is mapped

checks.name: class members
checks.expected: every public member of every exported class is mapped

checks.name: record fields
checks.expected: every field is mapped with its offset and type

checks.name: enum members
checks.expected: every enum member is mapped

checks.name: one expansion
checks.expected: each record, enum and class is expanded exactly once

checks.name: modules
checks.expected: every module of the package is a group

checks.name: writes classified
checks.expected: the known acting members are classified as writes

checks.name: reads classified
checks.expected: the known reading members are classified as reads

checks.name: reasons kept
checks.expected: every member carries the reason for its classification

checks.name: writes skipped
checks.expected: a write is skipped unless writes are asked for

checks.name: writes reachable
checks.expected: with writes asked for the member is called, not skipped

checks.name: unknowns reported
checks.expected: unclassified members are reported, never hidden

checks.name: walk is clean
checks.expected: a 4,000-entry walk raises nothing unexpected

checks.name: Utils.DegToRad
checks.expected: DegToRad(180) is pi

checks.name: Utils.Distance
checks.expected: Distance((0,0),(3,4)) is 5

checks.name: AutoIt constants
checks.expected: the GUI constants are AutoIt's own values

checks.name: colour order
checks.expected: colorref 0x0000FF is #ff0000

checks.name: player status
checks.expected: GetPlayerStatusNameFromValue(0) is 'offline'

checks.name: skill names
checks.expected: a skill id maps to its name and back

checks.name: PerfCounter
checks.expected: a metric that was measured is reported

checks.name: pattern catalog
checks.expected: the offsets directory loads its patterns

checks.name: Win32 answers
checks.expected: Win32 answers a bool, a list and a formatted table

checks.name: enumerations
checks.expected: Allegiance enumerates its members

checks.name: record round trip
checks.expected: a record holds what was put in it

checks.name: refusal without a client
checks.expected: a client-facing reader answers the map id, or refuses and says a client is needed

checks.name: tabs
checks.expected: the window has its six tabs

checks.name: map built
checks.expected: the window built the whole map

checks.name: group list
checks.expected: the group list is filled

checks.name: search and run
checks.expected: a searched entry runs to an answer

checks.name: subset test
checks.expected: Test this class runs that class's entries

checks.name: reports
checks.expected: both reports are written

checks.name: elevated
checks.expected: the controller is elevated

checks.name: discovered
checks.expected: a Guild Wars client is running

checks.name: connected
checks.expected: the window holds a live connection

checks.name: window contexts
checks.expected: every context view refreshed without a read failure

checks.name: surface reads
checks.expected: the map's reads ran against the client with no failure

checks.name: every reader
checks.expected: each of the 22 context readers answers a snapshot or refuses in its own words

checks.name: character context
checks.expected: in a map, named, with a four-word uuid and a coherent login flag

checks.name: map, region, instance
checks.expected: an id above zero, a known region, a kind, boundaries ordered, a party size

checks.name: the controlled character
checks.expected: a live agent id, finite position, a real hp fraction, an agent name

checks.name: the agent array
checks.expected: the player is in it, positions are finite, ids are unique, allegiances are known

checks.name: the party
checks.expected: GetPartySize equals the three arrays, and the leader is the player

checks.name: the world record
checks.expected: the controlled-character record agrees with Player and holds a real area

checks.name: the camera
checks.expected: radian angles in range, a finite position, and a look-at point distinct from it

checks.name: the text parser
checks.expected: the file table holds 1,024 entries per file with 11 language slots

checks.name: instance and server region
checks.expected: a typed instance, a map record with ordered party sizes, terrain corners ending beyond their start

checks.name: items and inventory
checks.expected: every item's id and quantity are real and its position is in a bag

checks.name: two paths, one fact
checks.expected: context, getter, world record and agent array agree on map, name, id, position, party

checks.name: every field and property
checks.expected: every context's fields and properties are read, and the dump is kept for output

checks.name: no write was called
checks.expected: every callable member classified as a write was blocked, and none was called
checks.saw: 210 callable write members were blocked and none was called; 36 classified writes are not actions: ['py4gw.frame_tree.frame_ids.FrameId.AcceptButton (str)', 'py4gw.frame_tree.frame_ids.FrameId.Chat (str)', 'py4gw.frame_tree.frame_ids.FrameId.ChatChannels (namespace)']
